initialization: identical complete released EAGLE3 trainable state and frozen32000 vocabulary; fresh optimizer for every run
labels: online frozen Llama3.1-8B-Instruct soft distributions for both response context policies
positions: Q disjoint integer strata of sorted eligible base positions; a SHA256 variate chooses uniformly within each stratum; paired policies share variates; nonuniform inclusion when strata sizes differ
eligibility: native_mask[s] and released_t2d[argmax_full_vocab(target_logits_original[s+1])] and s>=6 and s+1<real_length; both policies must have at leastQ
schedule: deterministic domain/rank/seed/cycle hash permutation; explicit per-example repeat occurrence; generalist cycles domains with rank offset,512 per domain/rank; policy pairs share schedule
skipped_step_policy: any optimizer overflow/skip invalidates the run; no extra updates to compensate
recovery: source-bound clean checkpoint resume; log logical committed exposure separately from all physical attempts and replayed work; exact physical-match claim invalid after lost-work replay
final_checkpoint: fixed successful step1536; no validation-selected checkpoints

compute_matching.reference: median of the eight per-run8x synchronized training-loop wall times within each seed block
compute_matching.criterion: each of eight runs must be within +/-10% of that median; also publish max/min ratio
compute_matching.include: online teacher, draft forward/backward, optimizer, cache-to-device input, loop journaling and synchronization; checkpoint/export time measured separately
compute_matching.cuda_events: per-rank default-stream event intervals with synchronize after each update; auxiliary-stream work included only when joined by the default stream
compute_matching.replays: all physical attempts charged separately, including lost work; no padding with sleep or extra learning
compute_matching.offline: report regeneration, eligibility, qualification and total allocation costs separately

evaluation.selection: fixed final step; no tuning on test prompts
evaluation.uncertainty: paired prompt bootstrap plus all three seed values; only three seed blocks
evaluation.oracle: per-domain best fixed drafter selected on dev only; report routing cost separately

pipeline_prerequisite.scope: prior independently reviewed full-model EAGLE3/EAGLE2/HASS implementation validation; new pilot training and exports require additional qualification

limitations: Legacy default reentrant checkpoint path disconnects nested decoder outputs; corrected non-reentrant path requires new source-bound qualification against a direct uncheckpointed native-function reference.
